OSM tags it fixme: 'outline needs verification'.
landmarks.modelNote: Original procedural sculpture to the published dimensions (30 m statue + 8 m pedestal = 38 m; 28 m arms) on the real summit location and the mapped pedestal outline. Silhouette is simplified; facing confidence medium-low.
